title: Beyond the doors
steps: Through the three doors at last; the stones are older and darker here; ahead, a long corridor crosses yours.
The loop got us through all three doors in one go.
Listen, steps down there: Dask walks his round along that corridor, and he looks this way a long while.
How do we cross if we do not know how long he looks?
We wait exactly as long as he looks: a program can do that.
